nusmp.skill.book_recombination.descripti: Henry Legolant's attribute: the magic house, and the town around it, is taken apart and put back together at your call - walls, swapped rooms, a drill of brick and mana, and the Raging Black Bull, a giant built of houses with tower horns and brick fists. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.raging_bla: The Raging Black Bull - the magic house rises out of the ground as a giant of stacked houses: a timber-framed belly, a chest of arched windows, roofs with a chimney and a small tree, two towers for horns, glowing eyes and fists of brick. It follows you, brings a fist down on the nearest foe and fires its cannons for a minute, and every step sends up a cloud of dust. It grows with your EP. (Henry Legolant's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_recombination.ultra_gian: Ultra Giant Bull - the Compound spell: your house-golem grows one and a half times, fires four cannons at a time and strikes harder for twenty seconds. The Raging Black Bull must already stand.
